title: Dog at Computer
description: A brown dog sits at a wooden desk and uses a keyboard with its front paws. The dog looks at a large computer monitor that shows one short word painted in orange.
prompt: A brown dog sits at a wooden desk facing away from the viewer and uses a keyboard with its front paws while looking at a large computer monitor. The monitor screen shows the word coffee painted in orange letters. A white mug a computer mouse and cables sit on the desk. The scene has plain beige walls and is painted in a realistic style with visible brush strokes.
